title: Data Engineer III - Data Platform
description:
**WHO WE ARE:**

Zinnia is the leading technology platform for accelerating life and annuities growth. With innovative enterprise solutions and data insights, Zinnia simplifies the experience of buying, selling, and administering insurance products. All of which enables more people to protect their financial futures. Our success is driven by a commitment to three core values: be bold, team up, deliver value – and that we do. Zinnia has over $180 billion in assets under administration, serves 100\+ carrier clients, 2500 distributors and partners, and over 2 million policyholders.

**WHO YOU ARE:**



You are a Data Engineer who wants to go deep on platform and infrastructure work — building the pipelines, storage, and platform foundations that the rest of the business builds on. You think in terms of well\-modeled data, reliable orchestration, and infrastructure that holds up under real production load.



You are comfortable with SQL and Python, know your way around AWS core services, and can take a clear set of requirements and turn them into solid, well\-tested outcomes. You are curious about how data platforms can be setup, scaled, integrated in the wider application ecosystem and resulting data feeds downstream analytics and machine learning use cases.


**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**


* Build and maintain scalable, reliable data platforms and pipelines that power analytics and data\-driven products across Zinnia.
* Work within the data platform's AWS infrastructure — storage, IAM, compute and orchestration services — implementing and tuning components under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Implement and integrate with telemetry and observability solutions for Infrastructure and Platform reliability.
* Provision and modify data infrastructure components (S3 buckets, IAM roles, Lambda, RDS/Aurora, compute resources) using Terraform, including Snowflake infrastructure\-as\-code (warehouses, roles, databases), working from existing modules and patterns.
* Familiarity with streaming or event\-driven data (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar)
* Package, deploy, and manage pipeline components as containerized services (ex: Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, ECS), including EKS cluster upgrades and configuration changes
* Implement data quality checks, monitoring, and basic lineage so downstream teams can trust the data they're consuming.
* Contribute to data governance, access control, and cost\-optimization practices within AWS and Snowflake.
* Troubleshoot pipeline and infrastructure issues, escalating and collaborating with senior engineers on complex or systemic problems.
* Write clear documentation and follow established technical standards for the data platform.
* Develop and maintain ELT/ETL workflows using Airflow, dbt, and Airbyte (or similar ingestion tools) for self\-serve data access
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted engineering tools and platforms (e.g., Claude, Cortex Code), LLM\-based workflows, and agentic automation to support infrastructure and platform changes


**WHAT YOU'LL NEED:**


* **4\+ years of experience in Data Engineering, with a focus on Data**
* **Hands\-on experience with AWS core services (e.g., S3, IAM, compute services)**
* **Strong proficiency in SQL and Python for data transformation and pipeline development.**
* **Experience with a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake or similar.**
* **Working knowledge of Airflow for orchestration and scheduling, including managed Airflow (MWAA) or similar hosted\-Airflow configuration and environment management.**
* **Experience/awareness with dbt, including dbt Cloud, for transformations, testing, documentation, and job/environment configuration.**
* **Solid understanding of data modeling fundamentals (dimensional and fact\-based designs).**
* Comfort working in agile, cross\-functional teams alongside more senior engineers, analysts, and data scientists.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.  

  

**Nice to have:**
* Exposure to MLOps concepts — training data pipelines, feature generation, or model monitoring data.
* Experience with Airbyte or similar ELT ingestion tools.
* Familiarity with CI/CD practices for data pipelines, including building and maintaining GitHub repositories and GitHub Actions pipelines.
* Experience in a regulated industry such as insurance or financial services.


**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?**



At Zinnia, you collaborate with smart, creative professionals who are dedicated to delivering cutting\-edge technologies, deeper data insights, and enhanced services to transform how insurance is done. Visit our website at www.zinnia.com for more information. Apply by completing the online application on the careers section of our website. We are an Equal Opportunity employer committed to a diverse workforce. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
**About HG**  

HG Insights is the pioneer of Revenue Growth Intelligence. For more than a decade, we have delivered comprehensive, AI\- driven datasets on B2B buyers, technology adoption, IT spend, and buyer intent, sourced from billions of data points.  

Today, we are a trusted partner to Fortune 500 technology companies, hyperscalers, and innovative B2B vendors seeking precise go\-to\-market analytics and decision\-making. Through an evolving suite of AI agents that incorporate first\-party data and buyer signals, HG Insights enables AI\-powered GTM automation across sales, marketing, RevOps, and data analytics teams, modernizing GTM execution from strategy through activation.


**About the Role**  

This is a senior individual contributor role on the team that builds and runs HG's data platform: everything between a raw vendor file landing in our lake and a finished dataset arriving in a customer's hands. It includes the transformation stack that turns messy external signals into product\-grade company attributes, the matching systems that decide which company a piece of evidence belongs to and the internal applications our analysts use to curate and correct the result.



You will be based in Pune, working with engineers at our Pune, US \& Brazil locations.


**What you'll do**


* Own the architecture of the data platform end to end, and make the calls on build vs. buy, batch vs. incremental, and where each workload belongs.
* Build the quality layer that catches silent failure: contracts at every handoff, freshness and completeness monitoring, and pipelines that quarantine bad data rather than publish it.
* Improve entity matching and attribution — and make match decisions explainable to the customers who depend on them.
* Make our release cycle boring. Recurring deliveries should not depend on people watching them.
* Treat compute cost as a first\-class engineering metric across Spark, orchestration, and the serving tier.

  


**What we are looking for**


* 15\+ years building production grade data engineering systems, with a minimum of 5 years in a staff or principal scope.
* Deep Spark and Databricks expertise at multi\-terabyte scale, including the operational side of lakehouse table formats — merges, compaction, small files, schema evolution.
* Strong SQL and dimensional modelling, and the judgment to know when to break the rules.
* Experience with performant and scalable OLTP setups (MySQL/Postgres).
* Airflow orchestration (DAGs, operators, sensors) and integration with Spark/Databricks*.*
* Proven experience in AWS ecosystems (EC2, S3, EMR).
* Hands\-on entity resolution, fuzzy matching, or record linkage at scale. This is central to what we do.
* Python/Scala/Java, with real software discipline: testing, CI/CD, code review, infrastructure as code is a plus.
* Experience in Docker \- Kubernetes, Terraform is a plus.
* Experience in integrating AI first implementations in traditional data engineering setups will greatly help in shaping our future designs.
* Experience with machine learning pipelines (Spark MLlib, Databricks ML) for predictive analytics.
* Knowledge of data governance frameworks and compliance standards (GDPR, CCPA).


**Preferred Qualifications**



B2B firmographic, technographic or intent data; streaming and CDC; warehouse\-to\-lakehouse migration experience.


**What we offer/Benefits**  

We take care of our people fully and genuinely. Every HG Insights employee receives comprehensive healthcare coverage for themselves and their families, a monthly wellness reimbursement and access to Able To professional mental health coaching for stress, anxiety and depression support as per the regions. For your financial future, US employees benefit from a 401(k) with up to 5% company matching and all UK employees are enrolled in a pension scheme. Every employee also receives stock options because the people who build this company should share in its success.  

We invest in your growth through an annual learning reimbursement and a genuine commitment to developing your career at every stage. And through our Culture Club, you will always have a real voice in shaping the kind of workplace we build together.


**Equal Opportunity Employer**  

HG Insights is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the event of a recruiter or agency submitting a resume or candidate without a signed agreement being in place, we explicitly reserve the right to pursue and hire such candidates without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of HG Insights.

title: Embedded System Engineer
description:
**Company Description**  
RAKwireless is a leading innovator in the Internet of Things (IoT) industry, dedicated to simplifying design complexities and accelerating time\-to\-market through its modular IoT solutions. Established in 2014 and headquartered in Shenzhen, China, the company operates R\&D centers in Beijing and Xi'an and maintains strategic partnerships across Asia, Europe, and the Americas.  
Driven by its "IoT Made Easy" philosophy, RAKwireless delivers high\-performance, energy\-efficient, and easy\-to\-deploy solutions for developers, system integrators, and IoT solution providers across a wide range of industries. Through its innovative hardware components and unified software ecosystem, RAKwireless aims to eliminate connectivity and interoperability barriers, empowering both emerging and established markets.

**Job Summary:**  
We are looking for a Embedded Systems Engineer to join our team to support customer deployments, proof\-of\-concept (POC) builds, and field testing for our modular IoT hardware ecosystem. In this role, you will work closely with hardware built on the RAKwireless ecosystem (core microcontrollers, wireless modules, and sensor boards). Your main goal will be to own technical troubleshooting, build practical demonstrations, run field coverage tests, and create comprehensive technical documentation. Ultimately serving as a key technical resource and reducing routine operational dependencies on senior SMEs.

​**Requirements**

***Experience:***Min 1 year of on paper experience is required.

***Key Responsibilities:***

* Troubleshooting \& Support: Reproduce, analyze, and troubleshoot customer\-reported hardware, firmware, and integration issues in lab environments.
* POCs \& Demos: Design, build, and deliver functional Proofs\-of\-Concept (POCs) and technical demonstrations using the RAKwireless WisBlock platform and related sensor/communication modules.
* Field Testing \& Deployment: Conduct on\-site and field tests to evaluate wireless coverage, range, power consumption, and reliability across various deployment scenarios (e.g., LoRaWAN, BLE, Cellular).
* Documentation \& Knowledge Base: Document engineering results, field test data, and integration steps as technical reference guides, application notes, and case studies.
* SME Offloading: Take ownership of standard hardware/firmware queries to streamline customer support and significantly reduce routine support burdens on core SMEs.

***Key Qualifications \& Requirements:***

* Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Electronics \& Telecommunication Engineering, Embedded Systems, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Hands\-on Hardware Experience: 1\) Practical experience working with modular development kits, LPWAN/IoT platforms preferred. 2\) Familiarity with micro\-controllers (e.g.,STM32, ESP32,) and sensor integration (I2C, SPI, UART, ADC).
* Wireless Technologies: Good understanding of LPWAN protocols (LoRa/LoRaWAN), Wi\-Fi, BLE, or Cellular IoT.
* Firmware \& Software: Proficiency in C / C\+\+ (Arduino IDE, STM32CubeIDE, PlatformIO) and introductory scripting tools (e.g., Python) for testing and data logging.
* Technical Debugging: Experience with electronic debugging tools (multimeters, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers) and board\-level troubleshooting.
* Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal technical communication skills to document case studies and interact clearly with both internal teams and external customers.
* Experience with network/protocol analyzers (e.g., Wireshark) or LoRaWAN Network Servers (ChirpStack, The Things Network).
* Basic understanding of PCB layout/schematics (KiCad, LTspice) to assist in root\-cause analysis.

title: Senior Engineer, Systems Engineering - Embedded Systems & PLC Controls
description:
**Job Title:**


Senior Engineer, Systems Engineering \- Embedded Systems \& PLC Controls**Job Description:**

**Senior****Embedded****Software/Firmware Engineer – Embedded Systems \& PLC Controls**

**Position Summary**


We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software/Firmware Engineer to develop, integrate, and support embedded software, firmware, and PLC\-based control systems for industrial and electromechanical products used in semiconductor manufacturing. The ideal candidate will have strong embedded C/C\+\+ development experience along with practical knowledge of real\-time control systems, industrial automation, and PLC integration.


This role will support product development and sustaining engineering from concept through commercialization. The engineer will collaborate with electrical, mechanical, systems, manufacturing, quality, and product teams to translate requirements into reliable designs; develop, test, debug, qualify, and document solutions; support hardware bring\-up and system integration; and resolve field and manufacturing issues through structured root\-cause analysis.


The primary focus is embedded firmware and system integration. PLC, HMI, and SCADA experience is important, but the successful candidate is not expected to be an expert in every platform or protocol listed below.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Design, develop, test, and maintain** embedded firmware for microcontroller\- and processor\-based systems using C/C\+\+.
* **Develop low\-level drivers**, communication stacks, middleware, and application software for embedded products.
* **Implement and optimize** real\-time control functions, including task scheduling, interrupt handling, state machines, timing, fault handling, and diagnostics.
* **Integrate embedded controllers** with PLCs, sensors, actuators, motors, drives, instrumentation, and industrial networks.
* **Implement, integrate, and troubleshoot** CAN, RS\-232/422/485, UART, SPI, I²C, USB, Ethernet, and TCP/IP communications.
* **Partner with electrical engineers** to bring up and validate new hardware platforms using JTAG/SWD debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and related equipment.
* **Translate product** **needs** into functional and non\-functional software requirements, interface specifications, architecture, timing and memory constraints, and verification criteria.
* **Create and maintain technical documentation**, including requirements, architecture descriptions, interface documents, process flows, state\-machine diagrams, test plans, test reports, release notes, and troubleshooting guides.
* **Develop unit, integration, regression**, hardware\-in\-the\-loop, and system\-level tests; create tools and scripts that improve automation, repeatability, diagnostic coverage, and data analysis.
* **Participate in architecture, design, and code reviews**; apply coding standards, version control, issue tracking, configuration management, and secure development practices.
* **Support stage\-gate and New Product Introduction** activities from concept and prototype through design verification, validation, qualification, release, and transfer to manufacturing.
* **Support sustaining engineering** by troubleshooting software, firmware, hardware\-interface, manufacturing, and field issues; perform root\-cause analysis and implement corrective actions.
* **Collaborate with domestic and international engineering teams**, product management, manufacturing, quality, customers, suppliers, and external development partners.
* **Estimate effort**, identify technical and schedule risks, communicate tradeoffs, and take ownership of assigned work through completion.
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 5\+ years of professional experience developing embedded software or firmware.
* Strong programming skills in C and C\+\+ for embedded systems.
* Hands\-on experience with RTOS concepts, embedded hardware architecture, interrupts, concurrency, timing, memory, and real\-time constraints.
* Experience developing low\-level drivers and integrating peripheral interfaces such as SPI, I²C, UART, CAN, and RS\-485\.
* Experience developing or integrating at least one industrial communication protocol or control network.
* Experience with Git or similar version\-control systems, code review, defect tracking, and controlled software release practices.
* Experience qualifying and validating software against written specifications through unit, integration, and system\-level testing.
* Ability to read schematics and troubleshoot embedded hardware and firmware interfaces using standard laboratory and debug equipment.
* Ability to create clear requirements, design documents, interface specifications, test plans, test reports, and troubleshooting documentation.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to prioritize work, manage multiple assignments, and deliver in a fast\-paced product\-development and sustaining environment.
**Nice to Have**

*Candidates are not expected to have every item listed below. These capabilities are considered nice to have and may broaden the candidate’s fit based on the products and technologies supported by the team.*

* Experience programming or integrating industrial PLC platforms such as Rockwell/Allen\-Bradley, Siemens, Beckhoff, or CODESYS.
* Experience developing or maintaining HMI and SCADA applications.
* Familiarity with industrial communication protocols such as CANopen, Modbus, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, EtherCAT, or OPC UA.
* Embedded Linux experience, including Yocto, Buildroot, board\-support packages, device drivers, or system services.
* **Develop and maintain PLC software** using one or more major platforms such as Rockwell/Allen\-Bradley, Siemens, Beckhoff, or CODESYS.
* **Create, integrate, and support** HMI and SCADA interfaces for industrial equipment and engineering test systems.
* Working knowledge of PLC programming or PLC\-to\-embedded\-system integrati
* Motor\-control experience involving stepper, BLDC, or servo drives, encoder feedback, PID tuning, or motion profiles.
* Digital signal\-processing experience, including filtering, sampling, high\-resolution ADCs, or sensor signal conditioning.
* Familiarity with semiconductor\-equipment communication standards such as SECS/GEM or HSMS.
* Experience with Python, C\#, automated test frameworks, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, containers, or hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing.
* FPGA/CPLD development or HDL familiarity.
* Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity frameworks such as SEMI E187/E188 or IEC 62443\.
* Experience supporting semiconductor equipment or other regulated, high\-reliability industrial products.
* Experience with stage\-gate development and New Product Introduction.
* Master’s degree in a relevant engineering or computer\-science discipline.
